Select exact IC50 activity rows for human MCH receptor 1 (CHEMBL344). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and docs. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and require pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR doi IS NOT NULL. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
